problems.stem: Which part of a research paper is the best candidate to delegate?
options: Formatting references you have already found and checked.
Choosing which evidence supports your argument.
problems.explanation: Formatting checked references is support work; the argument is core work.

problems.stem: Why can delegating core work hurt you even if the result looks good?
options: Because you skip practicing the skill the assignment is meant to build.
problems.explanation: Learning comes from doing the thinking; outsourcing it removes the practice.

problems.stem: Who is responsible for work you submit that used AI?
problems.explanation: You remain accountable for what you submit.
